headline: How Fireflies Make Light

sentences.en: On a summer night, small lights blinking over a field are often fireflies, which are actually a kind of **beetle**.
chunks: small lights blinking over a field

sentences.en: Their light comes from a chemical **reaction** inside their bodies, in which a substance called luciferin mixes with oxygen.
chunks: in which a substance called luciferin

sentences.en: Unlike a light bulb, this light **gives off** almost no heat, so it is often called cold light.
Fireflies use their flashes mainly to find a **partner**, and each **species** has its own pattern of flashes, like a secret code.
chunks: has its own pattern of flashes,

sentences.en: In many species, males flash while flying, and **females** waiting in the grass answer with flashes of their own.
chunks: answer with flashes of their own.

sentences.en: Because fireflies need dark nights, too much **artificial** light can make it harder for them to find each other.
chunks: can make it harder for them

points.title: in which
points.body: `a chemical reaction ..., in which a substance called luciferin mixes with oxygen`에서 `in which`는 '그 반응 안에서'예요. 앞의 reaction을 받아서 무슨 일이 일어나는지 설명해요.

points.title: of their own
points.body: `answer with flashes of their own`은 '자기만의 깜빡임으로 답한다'예요. 남의 신호를 따라 하는 게 아니라 스스로 신호를 보낸다는 뜻이에요.

answers: 여름밤 들판 위에서 깜빡이는 작은 불빛은 대개 반딧불이인데, 반딧불이는 사실 딱정벌레의 한 종류다.
그 빛은 몸 안의 화학 반응에서 나오는데, 이 반응에서 루시페린이라는 물질이 산소와 섞인다.
전구와 달리 이 빛은 열을 거의 내지 않아서, 흔히 '차가운 빛'이라고 불린다.
반딧불이는 주로 짝을 찾으려고 빛을 깜빡이고, 종마다 비밀 암호처럼 고유한 깜빡임 패턴이 있다.
많은 종에서 수컷은 날아다니며 빛을 깜빡이고, 풀숲에서 기다리는 암컷은 자기만의 깜빡임으로 답한다.
반딧불이에게는 어두운 밤이 필요하기 때문에, 인공 불빛이 너무 많으면 서로를 찾기가 더 어려워질 수 있다.

advanced.example: Fireflies **emit** light with almost no heat.
Firefly light is far more **efficient** than a light bulb.
Each species has a **distinctive** flash pattern.
Females **respond** to males with flashes of their own.
Bright city lights can **disrupt** their signals.
